i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            ny = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nz = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (ny == 0) ny = nx;\n    if (nz == 0) nz = nx;\n    \n    printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n    printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    size_t gridSize = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    // Allocate grids (double buffering)\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(gridSize);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(gridSize);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    initializeGrid(grid1, nx, ny, nz);\n    \n    // Run stencil iterations\n    printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int iter = 0;     // padded element count\n\n    // Padded index of an owned cell given owned-local coordinates\n    size_t at(size_t z, size_t y, size_t x) const { return (z + 1) * sxy + (y + 1) * sx + (x + 1); }\n};\n\n// Start and length of block c when n cells are split over p blocks\ninline void blockExtent(const size_t n, const int p, const int c, size_t& start, size_t& len) {\n    start = n * c / p;\n    len = n * (c + 1) / p - start;\n}\n\n// Chooses a 3D process grid (z, y, x) with at most one block per cell along each axis.\n// Picks the factorization with the least total internal face area, i.e. the least halo traffic.\nbool chooseProcessGrid(const int nprocs, const size_t n[3], int p[3]) {\n    bool found = false;\n    double best = 0.0;\n    for (int pz = 1; pz <= nprocs; ++pz) {\n        if (nprocs % pz) continue;\n        const int rest = nprocs / pz;\n        for (int py = 1; py <= rest; ++py) {\n            if (rest % py) continue;\n            const int px = rest / py;\n            if (static_cast<size_t>(pz) > n[0] || static_cast<size_t>(py) > n[1] || static_cast<size_t>(px) > n[2]) continue;\n            const double cost = (pz - 1.0) * n[1] * n[2] + (py - 1.0) * n[0] * n[2] + (px - 1.0) * n[0] * n[1];\n            if (!found || cost < best) {\n                found = true;\n                best = cost;\n                p[0] = pz;\n                p[1] = py;\n                p[2] = px;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\nvoid initializeBlock(std::vector<Real>& buf, const Block& b, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < b.len[0]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < b.len[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < b.len[2]; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(b.start[2] + x, b.start[1] + y, b.start[0] + z, nx, ny);\n                buf[b.at(z, y, x)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Half-open range of owned-local indices along one axis\nstruct Range {\n    size_t lo;\n    size_t hi;\n    bool empty() const { return lo >= hi; }\n};\n\n// Owned-local cells along one axis that the stencil updates. Global boundary cells are fixed.\nRange updateRange(const size_t start, const size_t len, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t lo = start >= 1 ? 0 : std::min<size_t>(len, 1 - start);\n    const size_t hi = start + 1 < n ? std::min<size_t>(len, n - 1 - start) : 0;\n    return {lo, hi};\n}\n\nstruct Box {\n    Range r[3];\n    bool empty() const { return r[0].empty() || r[1].empty() || r[2].empty(); }\n};\n\n// Applies the 7-point averaging stencil to every cell of a box. Expression order matches the serial code.\nvoid sweep(const Real* __restrict in, Real* __restrict out, const Box& b, const Block& blk) {\n    if (b.empty()) return;\n    const size_t count = b.r[2].hi - b.r[2].lo;\n    for (size_t z = b.r[0].lo; z < b.r[0].hi; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = b.r[1].lo; y < b.r[1].hi; ++y) {\n            const size_t base = blk.at(z, y, b.r[2].lo);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n                const size_t p = base + i;\n                out[p] = (in[p] + in[p - 1] + in[p + 1] + in[p - blk.sx] + in[p + blk.sx] + in[p - blk.sxy] + in[p + blk.sxy]) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Subarray datatype selecting one face: the outermost owned layer (send) or the halo layer just outside (receive)\nMPI_Datatype makeFaceType(const Block& b, const int face, const bool send) {\n    const int axis = face / 2;\n    const bool high = face % 2 == 1;\n    int sizes[3] = {static_cast<int>(b.len[0] + 2), static_cast<int>(b.len[1] + 2), static_cast<int>(b.len[2] + 2)};\n    int subsizes[3] = {static_cast<int>(b.len[0]), static_cast<int>(b.len[1]), static_cast<int>(b.len[2])};\n    int starts[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    subsizes[axis] = 1;\n    if (send) {\n        starts[axis] = high ? static_cast<int>(b.len[axis]) : 1;\n    } else {\n        starts[axis] = high ? static_cast<int>(b.len[axis]) + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    MPI_Datatype type;\n    MPI_Type_create_subarray(3, sizes, subsizes, starts, MPI_ORDER_C, MPI_DOUBLE, &type);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&type);\n    return type;\n}\n\n// Persistent halo exchange for both grid buffers. Requests [0, kFaces) receive, [kFaces, 2*kFaces) send.\nstruct Halo {\n    MPI_Datatype sendType[kFaces];\n    MPI_Datatype recvType[kFaces];\n    MPI_Request req[2][2 * kFaces];\n};\n\nvoid setupHalo(Halo& halo, const Block& b, MPI_Comm cart, const int nbr[kFaces], Real* const bufs[2]) {\n    for (int f = 0; f < kFaces; ++f) {\n        halo.sendType[f] = makeFaceType(b, f, true);\n        halo.recvType[f] = makeFaceType(b, f, false);\n    }\n    for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {\n        for (int f = 0; f < kFaces; ++f) {\n            // A face-f message is tagged f by the sender; the neighbour on side f sends toward us on its face f ^ 1\n            MPI_Recv_init(bufs[k], 1, halo.recvType[f], nbr[f], f ^ 1, cart, &halo.req[k][f]);\n            MPI_Send_init(bufs[k], 1, halo.sendType[f], nbr[f], f, cart, &halo.req[k][kFaces + f]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid freeHalo(Halo& halo) {\n    for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * kFaces; ++i) {\n            MPI_Request_free(&halo.req[k][i]);\n        }\n    }\n    for (int f = 0; f < kFaces; ++f) {\n        MPI_Type_free(&halo.sendType[f]);\n        MPI_Type_free(&halo.recvType[f]);\n    }\n}\n\n// Copies the owned cells of a block, in z, y, x order, into a dense array\nvoid packBlock(const Block& b, const Real* buf, std::vector<Real>& packed) {\n    size_t p = 0;\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < b.len[0]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < b.len[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < b.len[2]; ++x) {\n                packed[p++] = buf[b.at(z, y, x)];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Writes a dense block into its place in the global grid (global layout is idx3 order)\nvoid placeBlock(std::vector<Real>& global, const size_t n[3], const size_t start[3], const size_t len[3], const Real* packed) {\n    size_t p = 0;\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < len[0]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < len[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < len[2]; ++x) {\n                global[idx3(start[2] + x, start[1] + y, start[0] + z, n[2], n[1])] = packed[p++];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Gathers the full grid on rank 0 (used only for printing results)\nstd::vector<Real> gatherGrid(MPI_Comm cart, const int nprocs, const size_t n[3], const Block& b, const Real* buf) {\n    const size_t count = b.len[0] * b.len[1] * b.len[2];\n    std::vector<Real> packed(count);\n    packBlock(b, buf, packed);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(cart, &rank);\n    if (rank != 0) {\n        MPI_Send(packed.data(), static_cast<int>(count), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, 0, cart);\n        return {};\n    }\n\n    std::vector<Real> global(n[0] * n[1] * n[2]);\n    placeBlock(global, n, b.start, b.len, packed.data());\n    for (int r = 1; r < nprocs; ++r) {\n        int coord[3];\n        MPI_Cart_coords(cart, r, 3, coord);\n        int procs[3];\n        MPI_Cart_get(cart, 3, procs, nullptr, nullptr);\n        size_t start[3];\n        size_t len[3];\n        for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n            blockExtent(n[a], procs[a], coord[a], start[a], len[a]);\n        }\n        const size_t rcount = len[0] * len[1] * len[2];\n        packed.resize(rcount);\n        MPI_Recv(packed.data(), static_cast<int>(rcount), MPI_DOUBLE, r, 0, cart, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        placeBlock(global, n, start, len, packed.data());\n    }\n    return global;\n}\n\n// Same checks as the serial validateResult(), evaluated collectively. Reports on the root rank only.\nbool validateDistributed(MPI_Comm cart, const bool root, const Block& b, const Real* buf) {\n    long long nonFinite = 0;\n    Real minVal = std::numeric_limits<Real>::max();\n    Real maxVal = std::numeric_limits<Real>::lowest();\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < b.len[0]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < b.len[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < b.len[2]; ++x) {\n                const Real val = buf[b.at(z, y, x)];\n                if (!std::isfinite(val)) {\n                    ++nonFinite;\n                } else {\n                    minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n                    maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 1. No NaN or Inf values\n    long long totalNonFinite = 0;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&nonFinite, &totalNonFinite, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, cart);\n    if (totalNonFinite > 0) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // 2. Values should be reasonable (bounded)\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &minVal, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MIN, cart);\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &maxVal, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, cart);\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Value range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n\n    if (maxVal > 1e6 || minVal < -1e6) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 128)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of iterations (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int worldRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldRank);\n    const bool worldRoot = worldRank == 0;\n\n    int nxArg = 128;\n    int nyArg = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int nzArg = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-x\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nxArg = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-y\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nyArg = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-z\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            nzArg = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-i\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            iterations = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (worldRoot) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (worldRoot) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (nyArg == 0) nyArg = nxArg;\n    if (nzArg == 0) nzArg = nxArg;\n\n    if (nxArg < 1 || nyArg < 1 || nzArg < 1 || iterations < 0) {\n        if (worldRoot) {\n            printf(\"Grid dimensions must be positive and the iteration count non-negative\\n\");\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    const size_t nx = nxArg;\n    const size_t ny = nyArg;\n    const size_t nz = nzArg;\n    const size_t n[3] = {nz, ny, nx};\n\n    int nprocs = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &nprocs);\n    int procs[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    if (!chooseProcessGrid(nprocs, n, procs)) {\n        if (worldRoot) printf(\"Cannot decompose %zu x %zu x %zu grid over %d MPI ranks\\n\", nx, ny, nz, nprocs);\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    // Reordering may renumber ranks, so the Cartesian communicator is used for everything from here on\n    const int periods[3] = {0, 0, 0};\n    MPI_Comm cart;\n    MPI_Cart_create(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 3, procs, periods, 1, &cart);\n    int rank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(cart, &rank);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    int coord[3];\n    MPI_Cart_coords(cart, rank, 3, coord);\n\n    Block blk{};\n    for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n        blockExtent(n[a], procs[a], coord[a], blk.start[a], blk.len[a]);\n    }\n    blk.sx = blk.len[2] + 2;\n    blk.sxy = blk.sx * (blk.len[1] + 2);\n    blk.total = blk.sxy * (blk.len[0] + 2);\n\n    int nbr[kFaces];\n    for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n        MPI_Cart_shift(cart, a, 1, &nbr[2 * a], &nbr[2 * a + 1]);\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"3D Stencil Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Grid size: %zu x %zu x %zu\\n\", nx, ny, nz);\n        printf(\"Iterations: %d\\n\", iterations);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Initializing grid...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Both buffers start identical, so their global boundary cells match from the first iteration on\n    std::vector<Real> grid1(blk.total, 0.0);\n    std::vector<Real> grid2(blk.total, 0.0);\n Range{upd.r[a].lo, inner.r[a].lo} : Range{inner.r[a].hi, upd.r[a].hi};\n                outer.push_back(b);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(cart);\n    const double t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        const int cur = iter % 2;\n        const Real* in = grids[cur];\n        Real* out = grids[1 - cur];\n\n        MPI_Startall(2 * kFaces, halo.req[cur]);\n        sweep(in, out, inner, blk);\n        MPI_Waitall(2 * kFaces, halo.req[cur], MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        for (const Box& b : outer) {\n            sweep(in, out, b, blk);\n        }\n    }\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - t0;\n    double maxElapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, cart);\n\n    const long ms = static_cast<long>(maxElapsed * 1000.0);\n    if (root) printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", ms);\n\n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (ms / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    if (root) printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n\n    const Real* finalBuf = grids[iterations % 2];\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<Real> global = gatherGrid(cart, nprocs, n, blk, finalBuf);\n        if (root) print_results(global, \"Grid\");\n    }\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = validateDistributed(cart, root, blk, finalBuf);\n        if (root) printf(valid ? \"Validation: PASSED\\n\" : \"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n        exitCode = valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    freeHalo(halo);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&cart);\n    return exitCode;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const int rc = runBenchmark(argc, argv);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":98,"newStart":1,"newLines":263,"lines":["+#include <mpi.h>","+"," #include <algorithm>","-#include <chrono>"," #include <cmath>"," #include <cstdio>"," #include <cstdlib>"," #include <cstring>","+#include <limits>","+#include <type_traits>"," #include <vector>"," "," #include \"../common/results_output.hpp\""," "," using Real = double;","+static_assert(std::is_same_v<Real, double>, \"halo exchange uses MPI_DOUBLE\");"," "," // 3D index calculation"," inline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {","     return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;"," }"," ","-void initializeGrid(std::vector<Real>& grid, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {","-    for (size_t z = 0; r < nprocs; ++r) {\n        int coord[3];\n        MPI_Cart_coords(cart, r, 3, coord);\n        size_t start[3];\n        size_t len[3];\n        for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n            blockExtent(n[a], procs[a], coord[a], start[a], len[a]);\n        }\n        const size_t rcount = len[0] * len[1] * len[2];\n        packed.resize(rcount);\n        MPI_Recv(packed.data(), static_cast<int>(rcount), MPI_DOUBLE, r, 0, cart, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        placeBlock(global, n, start, len, packed.data());\n    }\n    return global;\n}\n\n// Same checks as the serial validateResult(), evaluated collectively. The inner part is computed while the halo messages are in flight.\n    Box upd;\n    for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n        upd.r[a] = updateRange(blk.start[a], blk.len[a], n[a]);\n    }\n    Box inner;\n    for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n        inner.r[a] = {std::max<size_t>(upd.r[a].lo, 1), std::min(upd.r[a].hi, blk.len[a] - 1)};\n    }\n    std::vector<Box> outer;\n    if (inner.empty()) {\n        outer.push_back(upd);\n    } else {\n        for (int a = 0; a < 3; ++a) {\n            for (int side = 0; side < 2; ++side) {\n                Box b = upd;\n                for (int k = 0; k < a; ++k) b.r[k] = inner.r[k];\n                b.r[a] = side == 0 ? Range{upd.r[a].lo, inner.r[a].lo} : Range{inner.r[a].hi, upd.r[a].hi};\n                outer.push_back(b);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Running stencil computation...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(cart);\n    const double t0 = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int iter = 0; iter < iterations; ++iter) {\n        const int cur = iter % 2;\n        const Real* in = grids[cur];\n        Real* out = grids[1 - cur];\n\n        MPI_Startall(2 * kFaces, halo.req[cur]);\n        sweep(in, out, inner, blk);\n        MPI_Waitall(2 * kFaces, halo.req[cur], MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        for (const Box& b : outer) {\n            sweep(in, out, b, blk);\n        }\n    }\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - t0;\n    double maxElapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, cart);\n\n    const long ms = static_cast<long>(maxElapsed * 1000.0);\n    if (root) printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", ms);\n\n    // Calculate performance metrics\n    double cellUpdates = (double)((nx-2) * (ny-2) * (nz-2)) * iterations;\n    double mcups = cellUpdates / (ms / 1000.0) / 1e6;  // Million cell updates per second\n    if (root) printf(\"Performance: %.3f MCellUpdates/s\\n\", mcups);\n\n    const Real* finalBuf = grids[iterations % 2];\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<Real> global = gatherGrid(cart, nprocs, n, blk, finalBuf);\n        if (root) print_results(global, \"Grid\");\n    }\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (root) printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        const bool valid = validateDistributed(cart, root, blk, finalBuf);\n        if (root) printf(valid ? \"Validation: PASSED\\n\" : \"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n        exitCode = valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    freeHalo(halo);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&cart);\n    return exitCode;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const int rc = runBenchmark(argc, argv);\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return rc;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":432,"oldLines":7,"newStart":432,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ","     // Print results for external validation","     if (printResults) {","-        std::vector<Real> global = gatherGrid(cart, nprocs, n, blk, finalBuf);","+        std::vector<Real> global = gatherGrid(cart, nprocs, procs, n, blk, finalBuf);","         if (root) print_results(global, \"Grid\");","     }"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_018BjcHf77T76zt4fw92cxmA","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

any remaining ranks sit out\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    int nprocs = worldSize;\n    int procs[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    while (!chooseProcessGrid(nprocs, n, procs)) --nprocs;\n\n    MPI_Comm active;\n    MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, worldRank < nprocs ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED, worldRank, &active);\n    if (active == MPI_COMM_NULL) return 0;\n\n    // Reordering may renumber ranks, so the Cartesian communicator is used for everything from here on\n    const int periods[3] = {0, 0, 0};\n    MPI_Comm cart;\n    MPI_Cart_create(active, 3, procs, periods, 1, &cart);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&active);","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <type_traits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nusing Real = double;\nstatic_assert(std::is_same_v<Real, double>, \"halo exchange uses MPI_DOUBLE\");\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Axes are ordered z, y, x (slowest to fastest in memory), matching idx3.\n// Face f = 2 * axis + side, where side 0 is the low and side 1 the high end of the axis.\nconstexpr int kFaces = 6;\n\n// Owned cells of one rank plus a one-cell halo on every side.\nstruct Block {\n    size_t start[3];  // global index of the first owned cell, per axis\n    size_t len[3];    // number of owned cells, per axis\n    size_t sx;        // padded stride along y\n    size_t sxy;       // padded stride along z\n    size_t total;     // padded element count\n\n    // Padded index of an owned cell given owned-local coordinates\n    size_t at(size_t z, size_t y, size_t x) const { return (z + 1) * sxy + (y + 1) * sx + (x + 1); }\n};\n\n// Start and length of block c when n cells are split over p blocks\ninline void blockExtent(const size_t n, const int p, const int c, size_t& start, size_t& len) {\n    start = n * c / p;\n    len = n * (c + 1) / p - start;\n}\n\n// Chooses a 3D process grid (z, y, x) with at most one block per cell along each axis.\n// Picks the factorization with the least total internal face area, i.e. the least halo traffic.\nbool chooseProcessGrid(const int nprocs, const size_t n[3], int p[3]) {\n    bool found = false;\n    double best = 0.0;\n    for (int pz = 1; pz <= nprocs; ++pz) {\n        if (nprocs % pz) continue;\n        const int rest = nprocs / pz;\n        for (int py = 1; py <= rest; ++py) {\n            if (rest % py) continue;\n            const int px = rest / py;\n            if (static_cast<size_t>(pz) > n[0] || static_cast<size_t>(py) > n[1] || static_cast<size_t>(px) > n[2]) continue;\n            const double cost = (pz - 1.0) * n[1] * n[2] + (py - 1.0) * n[0] * n[2] + (px - 1.0) * n[0] * n[1];\n            if (!found || cost < best) {\n                found = true;\n                best = cost;\n                p[0] = pz;\n                p[1] = py;\n                p[2] = px;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\nvoid initializeBlock(std::vector<Real>& buf, const Block& b, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < b.len[0]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < b.len[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < b.len[2]; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(b.start[2] + x, b.start[1] + y, b.start[0] + z, nx, ny);\n                buf[b.at(z, y, x)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Half-open range of owned-local indices along one axis\nstruct Range {\n    size_t lo;\n    size_t hi;\n    bool empty() const { return lo >= hi; }\n};\n\n// Owned-local cells along one axis that the stencil updates. Global boundary cells are fixed.\nRange updateRange(const size_t start, const size_t len, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t lo = start >= 1 ? 0 : std::min<size_t>(len, 1 - start);\n    const size_t hi = start + 1 < n ? std::min<size_t>(len, n - 1 - start) : 0;\n    return {lo, hi};\n}\n\nstruct Box {\n    Range r[3];\n    bool empty() const { return r[0].empty() || r[1].empty() || r[2].empty(); }\n};\n\n// Applies the 7-point averaging stencil to every cell of a box. Expression order matches the serial code.\nvoid sweep(const Real* __restrict in, Real* __restrict out, const Box& b, const Block& blk) {\n    if (b.empty()) return;\n    const size_t count = b.r[2].hi - b.r[2].lo;\n    for (size_t z = b.r[0].lo; z < b.r[0].hi; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = b.r[1].lo; y < b.r[1].hi; ++y) {\n            const size_t base = blk.at(z, y, b.r[2].lo);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n                const size_t p = base + i;\n                out[p] = (in[p] + in[p - 1] + in[p + 1] + in[p - blk.sx] + in[p + blk.sx] + in[p - blk.sxy] + in[p + blk.sxy]) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Subarray datatype selecting one face: the outermost owned layer (send) or the halo layer just outside (receive)\nMPI_Datatype makeFaceType(const Block& b, const int face, const bool send) {\n    const int axis = face / 2;\n    const bool high = face % 2 == 1;\n    int sizes[3] = {static_cast<int>(b.len[0] + 2), static_cast<int>(b.len[1] + 2), static_cast<int>(b.len[2] + 2)};\n    int subsizes[3] = {static_cast<int>(b.len[0]), static_cast<int>(b.len[1]), static_cast<int>(b.len[2])};\n    int starts[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    subsizes[axis] = 1;\n    if (send) {\n        starts[axis] = high ? static_cast<int>(b.len[axis]) : 1;\n    } else {\n        starts[axis] = high ? static_cast<int>(b.len[axis]) + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    MPI_Datatype type;\n    MPI_Type_create_subarray(3, sizes, subsizes, starts, MPI_ORDER_C, MPI_DOUBLE, &type);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&type);\n    return type;\n}\n\n// Persistent halo exchange for both grid buffers. Requests [0, kFaces) receive, [kFaces, 2*kFaces) send.\nstruct Halo {\n    MPI_Datatype sendType[kFaces];\n    MPI_Datatype recvType[kFaces];\n    MPI_Request req[2][2 * kFaces];\n};\n\nvoid setupHalo(Halo& halo, const Block& b, MPI_Comm cart, const int nbr[kFaces], Real* const bufs[2]) {\n    for (int f = 0; Reports on the root rank only.\nbool validateDistributed(MPI_Comm cart, const bool root, const Block& b, const Real* buf) {\n    long long nonFinite = 0;\n    Real minVal = std::numeric_limits<Real>::max();\n    Real maxVal = std::numeric_limits<Real>::lowest();\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < b.len[0]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < b.len[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < b.len[2]; ++x) {\n                const Real val = buf[b.at(z, y, x)];\n                if (!std::isfinite(val)) {\n                    ++nonFinite;\n                } else {\n                    minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n                    maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 1.  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int nzArg = 0;  // Will be set to nx if not specified\n    int iterations = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; any remaining ranks sit out\n    int worldSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n    int nprocs = worldSize;\n    int procs[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    while (!chooseProcessGrid(nprocs, n, procs)) --nprocs;\n\n    MPI_Comm active;\n    MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, worldRank < nprocs ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED, worldRank, &active);\n    if (active == MPI_COMM_NULL) return 0;\n\n    // Reordering may renumber ranks, so the Cartesian communicator is used for everything from here on\n    const int periods[3] = {0, 0, 0};\n    MPI_Comm cart;\n    MPI_Cart_create(active, 3, procs, periods, 1, &cart);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&active);\n    int rank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(cart, &rank);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    int coord[3];\n    MPI_Cart_coords(cart, rank, 3, coord);\n\n    Block blk{};\n    for (int a = 0;  // global index of the first owned cell, per axis\n    size_t len[3];    // number of owned cells, per axis\n    size_t sx;        // padded stride along y\n    size_t sxy;       // padded stride along z\n    size_t total;     // padded element count\n\n    // Padded index of an owned cell given owned-local coordinates\n    size_t at(size_t z, size_t y, size_t x) const { return (z + 1) * sxy + (y + 1) * sx + (x + 1); }\n};\n\n// Start and length of block c when n cells are split over p blocks\ninline void blockExtent(const size_t n, const int p, const int c, size_t& start, size_t& len) {\n    start = n * c / p;\n    len = n * (c + 1) / p - start;\n}\n\n// Chooses a 3D process grid (z, y, x) with at most one block per cell along each axis.\n// Picks the factorization with the least total internal face area, i.e. the least halo traffic.\nbool chooseProcessGrid(const int nprocs, const size_t n[3], int p[3]) {\n    bool found = false;\n    double best = 0.0;\n    for (int pz = 1; pz <= nprocs; ++pz) {\n        if (nprocs % pz) continue;\n        const int rest = nprocs / pz;\n        for (int py = 1; py <= rest; ++py) {\n            if (rest % py) continue;\n            const int px = rest / py;\n            if (static_cast<size_t>(pz) > n[0] || static_cast<size_t>(py) > n[1] || static_cast<size_t>(px) > n[2]) continue;\n            const double cost = (pz - 1.0) * n[1] * n[2] + (py - 1.0) * n[0] * n[2] + (px - 1.0) * n[0] * n[1];\n            if (!found || cost < best) {\n                found = true;\n                best = cost;\n                p[0] = pz;\n                p[1] = py;\n                p[2] = px;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return found;\n}\n\nvoid initializeBlock(std::vector<Real>& buf, const Block& b, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < b.len[0]; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < b.len[1]; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < b.len[2]; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(b.start[2] + x, b.start[1] + y, b.start[0] + z, nx, ny);\n                buf[b.at(z, y, x)] = (idx % 19) * 1.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Half-open range of owned-local indices along one axis\nstruct Range {\n    size_t lo;\n    size_t hi;\n    bool empty() const { return lo >= hi; }\n};\n\n// Owned-local cells along one axis that the stencil updates. Global boundary cells are fixed.\nRange updateRange(const size_t start, const size_t len, const size_t n) {\n    const size_t lo = start >= 1 ? 0 : std::min<size_t>(len, 1 - start);\n    const size_t hi = start + 1 < n ? std::min<size_t>(len, n - 1 - start) : 0;\n    return {lo, hi};\n}\n\nstruct Box {\n    Range r[3];\n    bool empty() const { return r[0].empty() || r[1].empty() || r[2].empty(); }\n};\n\n// Applies the 7-point averaging stencil to every cell of a box. Expression order matches the serial code.\nvoid sweep(const Real* __restrict in, Real* __restrict out, const Box& b, const Block& blk) {\n    if (b.empty()) return;\n    const size_t count = b.r[2].hi - b.r[2].lo;\n    for (size_t z = b.r[0].lo; z < b.r[0].hi; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = b.r[1].lo; y < b.r[1].hi; ++y) {\n            const size_t base = blk.at(z, y, b.r[2].lo);\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {\n                const size_t p = base + i;\n                out[p] = (in[p] + in[p - 1] + in[p + 1] + in[p - blk.sx] + in[p + blk.sx] + in[p - blk.sxy] + in[p + blk.sxy]) / 7.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Subarray datatype selecting one face: the outermost owned layer (send) or the halo layer just outside (receive)\nMPI_Datatype makeFaceType(const Block& b, const int face, const bool send) {\n    const int axis = face / 2;\n    const bool high = face % 2 == 1;\n    int sizes[3] = {static_cast<int>(b.len[0] + 2), static_cast<int>(b.len[1] + 2), static_cast<int>(b.len[2] + 2)};\n    int subsizes[3] = {static_cast<int>(b.len[0]), static_cast<int>(b.len[1]), static_cast<int>(b.len[2])};\n    int starts[3] = {1, 1, 1};\n    subsizes[axis] = 1;\n    if (send) {\n        starts[axis] = high ? static_cast<int>(b.len[axis]) : 1;\n    } else {\n        starts[axis] = high ? static_cast<int>(b.len[axis]) + 1 : 0;\n    }\n    MPI_Datatype type;\n    MPI_Type_create_subarray(3, sizes, subsizes, starts, MPI_ORDER_C, MPI_DOUBLE, &type);\n    MPI_Type_commit(&type);\n    return type;\n}\n\n// Persistent halo exchange for both grid buffers. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1p6AsnLVNsYWmJnxzWx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The stencil benchmark now runs under MPI, and its output matches the original serial program exactly. I changed only `stencil3d/stencil3d.cpp` and `stencil3d/CMakeLists.txt`, with no new files, and the executable is still `stencil3d`.\n\n**Verification**\n- Compared the full `-r -v` output (sums, min/max, samples, hash, validation) against the original serial build over 81 runs: 9 grid shapes, including odd sizes, a 1×1×1 grid, and zero iterations, each at 1 to 12 ranks. All 81 are identical.\n- Larger check at 256×200×96 for 3, 8, and 16 ranks: identical to serial.\n- Strong scaling at 384³, 20 iterations, one node: 897 MCUPS on 1 rank, 3716 on 8, 5309 on 32. The 16-rank point dipped below the 8-rank point, likely host noise.\n\n**Design**\n- 3D block decomposition over (z, y, x). Process-grid shape is chosen to minimize total internal face area, which is the halo traffic.\n- One-cell halo, exchanged with persistent non-blocking sends and receives. Face layers are described with subarray datatypes, so there is no manual packing.\n- The inner part of each block is computed while halo messages are in flight; the outer shell is computed after the wait.\n- Each cell uses the original expression order, so results are bit-identical rather than just close.\n- `-r` gathers the full grid to rank 0 only for printing, because the FNV hash has to run over the grid in order. `-v` validates with collective reductions and never gathers.\n- If a grid has fewer cells than ranks, the largest decomposable rank count is used and the surplus ranks sit out.\n\n**Behavior changes**\n- A zero or negative grid dimension, or a negative `-i`, is now rejected with a usage message. The original crashed or produced nonsense in those cases.\n- `Computation time` now comes from `MPI_Wtime`, reduced as the maximum across ranks.\n\n**Not verified**\n- Only tested on one node with Open MPI 4.1.6, using oversubscription for the correctness runs. I did not test multi-node behavior.\n- The build prints warnings from Open MPI's C++ bindings header under `-Wall -Wextra`. None come from the stencil code, and I did not add vendor-specific macros to silence them."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":484,"cache_read_input_tokens":86916,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":484},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"95845ac2-7d2b-4959-8fee-86195b3a4a1f","uuid":"bdde7b4a-3008-4348-9f0c-4c728ec890b2","timestamp":"2026-10-14T08:27:29.609Z","request_id":"req_011Cg1p6AYgJ2qb7P8zLaWM6"}
